raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: llama-cloud
  version: "2.13.0"

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/llama_cloud-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 3558cef00e6694f3c1de63de5881bd6a8563a6f72f2fcdae45fc46937de6ec2f

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv --no-deps --no-build-isolation

requirements:
  host:
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - hatchling
    - hatch-fancy-pypi-readme
    - pip
  run:
    - anyio >=3.5.0,<5
    - distro >=1.7.0,<2
    - sniffio
    - typing_extensions >=4.14,<5
    - python >=${{ python_min }},<4.0
    - pydantic >=1.9.0,<3
    - httpx >=0.23.0,<1
tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - llama_cloud
      python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*
  - requirements:
      run:
        - pip
        - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    script:
      - pip check

about:
  summary: Turn your enterprise data into production-ready LLM applications
  license: MIT
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://cloud.llamaindex.ai

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - jan-janssen
